## data.loading

```{r}
seur <- readRDS("./RData/seur.rds")
sce_inf <- readRDS("./RData/01_sce_inf.rds")
```


### Fig.S1A

```{r}
options(repr.plot.width = 10, repr.plot.height = 6)
genes <- c("CD3D", "CD4", "CD8A", "TYROBP", "KLRF1",
           "MS4A1", "SDC1", "CD68", "HLA-DRA", "EPCAM",
          "TPO", "TG", "COL3A1", "ENG", "PECAM1")
suppressMessages({
p_list <- list()
for(gene in genes){
  p_list[[gene]] <- FeaturePlot(seur, gene, pt.size = 1) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 18),
           axis.text = element_blank(), 
           axis.title = element_blank(), 
           axis.line = element_blank(), 
           axis.ticks = element_blank()) +
    NoLegend()
}

p = ggarrange(plotlist = p_list, ncol = 5, nrow = 3)
annotate_figure(p, top = text_grob("Fig.S1A markers", 
               color = "black", face = "bold", size = 20))
    })
```

### Fig.S1B

```{r fig.width=6, fig.height=2}
QCmetric <- readRDS("./RData/01_QCsigDat.rds")
QCmetric <- merge(QCmetric, sce_inf[, c("cell_lineages", "AIT")], by.x = 0, by.y = 0)
fea <- c("ImmuneEstimate", "StromalEstimate", "TDS", "sample_cnv")
pics <- lapply(fea, function(z){
  ggboxplot(QCmetric, x = "cell_lineages", y = z, 
            fill = "cell_lineages", width = 0.4, add = "none",
            outlier.shape = NA) + 
     coord_flip() +
    ggtitle(z) + xlab("") + ylab("") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = cell_lineages_colors) + 
    NoLegend()
})
plot_grid(plotlist = pics[c(1,2)], nrow = 1)
```

### Fig.S1C

```{r fig.width=6, fig.height=2}
plot_grid(plotlist = pics[c(3,4)], nrow = 1)
```

### Fig.s1F

```{r fig.width=7, fig.height=3}
(load("./RData/01_tumor_milOR.RData"))
tumor_da$cell_lineages <- factor(tumor_da$cell_lineages, 
                                 levels = rev(names(cell_lineages_colors)))

tumor_sig_da <- tumor_da[tumor_da$FDR < 0.05, ]
p.sig <- plotNhoodGraphDA(PTCmilo, tumor_sig_da, alpha = 0.1)
p.sig <- p.sig + scale_fill_gradient2(
  low = "#1F78B4",      
  mid = "white",
  high =   "#E31A1C",  
  midpoint = 0,
  name = "logFC"
) +  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

p1 <- plotDAbeeswarm(tumor_da, group.by = "cell_lineages", alpha = 0.3)
p1 <- p1 + scale_color_gradient2(
  low = "#1F78B4",      
  high =   "#E31A1C",  
  midpoint = 0,
  name = "logFC"
)

plot_grid(p.sig, p1, nrow = 1)
```

### Fig.S1G


```{r}
tme_inf <- subset(sce_inf, !(cell_lineages %in% c("Epithelial.cells")))
heatorder <- readRDS("./RData/01_heatmapOrder.rds")
cell_anno <- readRDS("./RData/01_cell_anno.rds")
```


```{r fig.width=8, fig.height=10}
pdat <- CalculatePro(meta = tme_inf, ID = "sampleType_AIT" ,
                     Cluster = "clusters_anno", usecol = c("sampleType", "AIT"))
pdat <- pdat %>% as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate(percent = ifelse(AIT == "Yes", -percent, percent))

maxV <- ceiling(max(abs(pdat$percent))); maxV
pdat %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = clusters_anno, y = percent, fill = sampleType_AIT)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = abs,
    breaks = seq(-18, 18, by = 4),
    limits = c(-18, 18)
  ) +
  facet_grid(~sampleType) + 
  scale_x_discrete(limits = rev(heatorder)) + 
   scale_fill_manual(values = sampleType_AIT_col) +
  labs(y = "", x = "", fill = "Group") 
```

### Fig.S1H

```{r fig.width=6, fig.height=2.5}
tme_inf$celltype <- plyr::mapvalues(tme_inf$clusters_anno, 
                                    from = cell_anno$clusters_anno, 
                                    to = cell_anno$type)
Typepdat <- CalculatePro(meta = tme_inf,
                         ID = "SID",
                         Cluster = "celltype", 
                         usecol = c("sampleType", "AIT", "sampleType_AIT"))
Typepdat$celltype <- factor(Typepdat$celltype, 
                           levels = c("Tumor-related",
                                      "Thyroid-related","AIT-related"))
Typepdat %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = sampleType_AIT , y = percent, 
             fill = sampleType_AIT)) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.6) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = sampleType_AIT_col) +
  facet_grid(~celltype) + 
  xlab("") + ylab("") +
   RotatedAxis() + theme(legend.position = "")
```

### Fig.S1I

```{r fig.width=6, fig.height=3}
tme_inf$sampleType_AIT <- factor(tme_inf$sampleType_AIT, 
                                 levels = c("AIT-PTC", "AIT-NAT", "AIT+NAT", "AIT+PTC"))
tme_inf %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = SID , fill = celltype)) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank()) + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = celltype_col) +
  facet_grid(~sampleType_AIT,scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") + 
  xlab("") + ylab("") 
```


### Fig.S1J

```{r fig.width=5, fig.height=12}
tmeMeta <- sce_inf %>% 
  dplyr::filter(cell_lineages != "Epithelial.cells")
dat <- tmeMeta %>% 
  dplyr::select(cell_names, clusters_anno, SID, sampleType_AIT, PID)
colnames(dat) <- c("CellBarcode", "majorCluster", "SampleID",
                     "loc", "patient")
dat$majorCluster <- as.character(dat$majorCluster)
distHeat <- calTissueDist(dat.tb = dat, byPatient = F, 
                colname.cluster = "majorCluster", 
                colname.patient = "patient",
                colname.tissue = "loc")

oedat <- as.matrix(distHeat)
bk <- c(seq(0, 1, by=0.01),seq(1.01,1.99,by=0.01))
sp_order <- c("AIT+PTC", "AIT+NAT", "AIT-NAT", "AIT-PTC")
oedat[heatorder, sp_order] %>%
  pheatmap::pheatmap(cluster_rows = FALSE,
                     cluster_cols = FALSE,
                     scale = "none",
                     color = c(colorRampPalette(colors = c(sampleType_colors[1],"white"))(length(bk)/2),
                               colorRampPalette(colors = c("white",sampleType_colors[2]))(length(bk)/2)),                     
                     breaks = bk,
                     border_color = NA, 
                     display_numbers = T,
                     annotation_legend = FALSE,
                    gaps_row = which(heatorder %in% c("Th17_CCR6", "CD4T_GZMK", "DC_CREM")),
                     number_color = "grey20", 
                     fontsize_number = 10,
                   )
```
